context: Daichi and Riku discuss a sports event.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: sports chat; vocabulary (スキー/観客/体力/クリア/かける) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: スキーの大会、観客が多かったなあ。
lines.en: The ski competition had a big crowd.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 選手は、体力がすごいよね。
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 練習に、何年もかけとるからな。
lines.en: They spend years training, after all.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 難所を、クリアした瞬間、最高だった!
lines.en: The moment they cleared the tough spot was the best!
lines.style: thrilled teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 観客みんな、拍手しとったわ。
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 体力をかけて、頑張ったんだね。
lines.en: They poured their stamina in and gave it their all.
lines.style: admiring teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 次のコースも、クリアしてほしいな。
lines.en: I hope they clear the next course too.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 観客として、応援に行きたいよ!
lines.en: I want to go cheer as a spectator!
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm closing delivery throughout
